name: dropin
title: Drop-in
description: A youth-centre theme on a gloss-white block wall, its programs racked down a strip of green baize, each one led by a flat numbered pool ball — solids, then stripes — with one big black figure and a donate button in eight-ball black.

tokens.--font-display: bold grotesque: headings, site title, menu, buttons, the impact figure, table figures, ball numerals
tokens.--text-s: small text: home-page row descriptions, dates, prompts, the footer
tokens.--text-l: ledes, the mission line, row titles and the words beside the impact figure
tokens.--text-xl: section headings and the figures in a table's first column
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles and the mission headline
tokens.--text-impact: size of the impact figure on the home page
tokens.--color-bg: gloss-white page background, and the painted plates behind the site title, menu and footer on the wall
tokens.--color-text: eight-ball black: text, headings, heavy rules, the focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: descriptions, dates, the verb beside the figure
tokens.--color-accent: eight-ball black: links, the donate button and the last menu entry, drawn as that button
tokens.--color-accent-ink: text and the round spot on the donate button
tokens.--color-border: thin rules between rows and table lines
tokens.--color-wall: the painted breeze blocks behind the masthead and footer, and the one course under the impact figure
tokens.--color-mortar: the mortar joints between those blocks
tokens.--color-panel: quiet panels: the get-involved block, quotes, code
tokens.--color-baize: green baize: the strip of cells holding the balls, and the cue ball's cell
tokens.--ball-ivory: white of the cue ball, the stripes' caps and the numeral spots
tokens.--ball-rim: pale rim around each ball, so the dark balls stand off the baize
tokens.--ball-size: diameter of a ball on list pages and the cue ball; the home rack and phones use smaller balls
tokens.--cell-width: width of the baize cell that holds each ball
tokens.--block-height: height of one course of breeze blocks; a block is twice as wide
tokens.--space-4: spacing scale — roomy, and the side margin
tokens.--rule: thickness of the heavy black rules
tokens.--focus-ring: thickness of the keyboard focus ring
